rationale: Round-3 pins gave the two best runs (T_eff 3.952/3.972 at the 4.50 ns floor). Setup still limits only at ss 100C 1.60V max-RC. Slack (+0.53/+0.55) exceeds the 0.4 ns margins, so repair met its goal, and both the target and the margins are at their limits. Other knobs matter little: util 47 (reg-to-reg limited, ~6% shorter wires) beat util 34 (IO-port limited) by 0.02 ns. Hold (+0.066/+0.078 ns, no hold buffers), slew/cap (0 vs bar 89), DRC (0) and wirelength (~6-7% over estimate, no congestion) leave room for the re-runs at tighter clocks. For the final round, keep the whole proven configuration so both runs repeat it, rather than gamble on synthesis or RC changes.
